card.name: Words just before 'develop' a disease
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'to', 'of', 'later', 'who' or 'group' placed right before a verb meaning to develop or be diagnosed with a disease. Seen in sentences about who gets a condition or its risk.

modes.label: Likelihood phrases
modes.description: 'to' or 'of' after 'more likely', 'odds' or 'risk', leading into getting a disease.
